name: jk-fashion
description: JK Fashion — orchestration only. The real apps live in frontend/ and backend/; this file exists so both dev servers start with one command. Its only dependency is `concurrently`.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
